Dear Brandon Nova,
Listed below is part or all of your exam schedule. If you are taking multiple exams, you will receive multiple emails.  Please review each carefully for accuracy. If you see any discrepancies, please contact me immediately.
AP Exam
Date
Student Arrival Time
Room Number
AP Computer Science Principles
Wednesday, May 15th
11:30:00 AM
Media Center

As a reminder, a parent or guardian MUST have completed the Google Form for you to leave campus after your morning exam.  If it has not been completed, you will return to class.
Below is information for the AP Exams for May 2024.  Please review ALL information carefully.
MOST afternoon AP exams end AFTER school ends (2:20).  Please ensure you have adequate transportation after your exam ends, as transportation is NOT provided.  You CANNOT be released from your exam early to ride a bus.
If you are testing in the GYM, we have found it to be VERY chilly as of late.  Please bring a jacket or sweatshirt to keep warm.
Before exam day:

  *   You will receive an email with your testing location.  Please check the location CAREFULLY.

*         You are required to arrive no later than 30 minutes prior to your exam: 7:30 a.m. for the morning administration and 11:30 a.m. for the afternoon administration. Students may not be dismissed until an exam has officially ended; do not ask to leave early if you finish before the end of the exam. If you play a sport or have a job, it is your responsibility to inform your coach or employer of your AP Exam obligation, and arrangements should be made accordingly.

*         If you have an AFTERNOON exam on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday or Friday, please go to A Lunch.  If you have an AFTERNOON exam on Wednesday, please go to your NORMAL lunch.
Be sure to bring these:

  *   No. 2 pencils for your multiple-choice answer sheet.
  *   Pens with black or dark blue ink for completing areas on the exam booklet covers and for free-response questions in most exams.
  *   Up to two approved calculators with the necessary capabilities if you're taking an AP Biology, Calculus, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Macroeconomics, Microeconomics, Physics or Statistics Exam. Visit THIS LINK<https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/exam-policies-guidelines/calculator-policies> to learn more about the calculator policy for each of these exams and for a list of authorized calculators.
  *   A current government-issued or school-issued photo ID. (Additional ID may be required by authorized test centers outside the United States.)
     *   Windermere Students: your WHS ID is sufficient.  The one on your phone is fine, but your phone MUST be turned off immediately after your ID has been checked.
  *   Your College Board SSD Accommodations Letter if you are taking an exam with approved testing accommodations.
  *   A watch that does not have internet access, does not beep or make noise and does not have an alarm.
  *   A ruler or straight edge ONLY if you are taking an AP Physics Exam.  Protractors are NOT allowed.
Don't bring these:

  *   Electronic equipment including phones, smartwatches, fitness trackers, wearable technology, cameras, recording or listening devices, or any other type of electronic or communication device.
     *   The only exceptions to the above restrictions are laptops or other devices specifically permitted to be used for in-school digital testing.
     *   School-owned and school-controlled digital recording devices are allowed only for the AP French, AP German, AP Italian, and AP Spanish Language and Culture Exams, and the AP Music Theory Exam.
  *   Books, reference guides, notes, compasses, protractors, mechanical pencils, pencils that are not No. 2, correction fluid, dictionaries, highlighters, or colored pencils.
  *   Scratch paper: Students testing in-school are prohibited from bringing scratch paper to the AP Exam, but scratch paper will be provided.
  *   Watches that beep, make a noise, or have an alarm.
  *   Computers or calculators that are not approved.
  *   Reference guides, keyboard maps, or other typing instructions.
  *   Ear plugs
  *   Earbuds
  *   Clothing or shoes with subject-related information.
  *   Food or drink (EXCEPTION - if you have multiple tests in one day, you may bring snacks to keep in your bag for between exams).
  *   Clipboards
A student observed with any of these prohibited items during testing or breaks may be dismissed from the exam, the device may be confiscated, the student's score may be canceled, and no retest may be permitted.

Details about required and prohibited items are in the AP Exam Terms and Conditions<https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/exam-policies-guidelines/terms-conditions>.
Should you have any questions, please contact me directly.
Amanda Newcomer, M. Ed.

*Something interesting: *

Dolphins sleep with one eye open. Only half of their brain sleeps at a
time, so when their left eye is closed, the right side of their brain is
resting. They do this because dolphins don't automatically breathe, it's a
conscious thing that they do, so part of their brain has to be constantly
awake.

Happy Monday!

Senior clearance begins tomorrow. You can help make this a faster process for yourself by completing all the following steps today before the end of the school day.  If any of these steps are not completed, you will have to remain in Student Services until you complete them. You will not receive your cap and gown, graduation tickets, etc. until you have completed all of the senior clearance items.

Your first stop will be in Student Services.  These are the steps that have to be completed prior to arriving:

a.            You will check to make sure you have all of your academic requirements for graduation (e.g., no failing classes for senior year).

b.            Senior Survey - this can be accessed via Xello.

?  Go to Launchpad and open Xello.

?  Senior Survey is on the home page.

c.            Go to SCOIR and update your final plans and where to send your transcript (if required).

?  Go to www.scoir.com<http://www.scoir.com/>.

?  Login to your account.

?  On the homepage of personal details, find "student outcomes and plans," then click "manage."

?  Update all of your colleges with their decisions, and then select the school where you are enrolling by clicking "mark as enrolling."

d.            Check if you completed your Florida Financial Aid Application (FFAA).

e.            Check if you completed your Free Application for Student Aid (FAFSA).

f.              Log your community service hours for Bright Futures. All hours must be turned in before graduation for you to be eligible for the scholarship (if you meet the other requirements).

the funky fish flops on the floor
using all its energy
to get to the door.

the door.
the door.

what lies beyond the door?

perhaps the fish could explore
and learn so much more.
inch by inch
the fish

no water
no food
no air
only the floor

if only the fish
could get to the door.

I vividly the relationship between rev and kora, the "4 letter r word”, as
we refer to it here, I vividly recall adrenaline coursing through my body
as I anxiously anticipated what I knew would be the ultimate showdown;
needless to say reality did not disappoint. The whole server was silent
from the second it started, till the second it ended, we watched silently
in anticipation, unable to predict what would happen. Once they began
conversing, their messages penetrated the silence and broke the sense of
awe which shifted to perpetual attention. I would not be surprised if they
got married at a motel 45 minutes from downtown, their chemistry is
undeniable and I can only envy them until I find “the one”! Their only true
weakness was a few peculiar moments, which I will elaborate upon in further
detail.

The beginning of the film consisted of what was initially the antagonist of
the movie: Rev “revving”, “Shapiro” and the well respected protagonist, the
legend of Kora. Their rivalry was intense, so much so, that it developed
into a [redacted] and several [redacted] scenes, a change a bit strange for
a mostly  [redacted] server like ours, however, one that is openly
welcomed!

Afterwards, both of them came together to defeat the imminent threat:
Alternate-Reverend-Thanos and Alternate-Thanos-Kora; the inclusion of a
multi-universe plot sets up the intricacy of the relationship, and it does
so in such great scientific accuracy. It is so accurate, as a matter of
fact, that in the credits scene the director, PewDiePie, included citations
in APA format for his directive decisions concerning scientific matters. As
a former Child Quantum Physicist, it was refreshing to see a film
accurately depict a multi-verse in such a true-to-life fashion!

That's not all! In the approaching moments, a finale between the forces of
good and evil, the Alternate Characters came together and fused, using
their signature catchphrases, "Shut the [expletive] up, [slur]" and “[skull
emoji]” This was such an unexpected turn of events that the entirety of the
server unanimously fell off their chairs in disbelief! It seemed that Rev
and Kora were done for, and my heart ached at the possibility that both of
these characters could die! Yet, in spite of the treachery, both
persevered, and using a mashup of their respective music tastes fought what
I can only describe as the most intense affray.

Fortunately, in a passion, both held one another in a warm embrace,
realizing that to truly appreciate life, they had to appreciate each other.

Their relationship is Moving. Emotional. Inspiring. Amazing. Real.

And always remember, your music taste is bad [skull emoji] !!!!!

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Natalie Miesak <4804135947@students.ocps.net>
To: Lauren Willman <4804089800@students.ocps.net>, Tyler Szydlo <4804136151@students.ocps.net>, Gianna Kim <4804135863@students.ocps.net>, Olivia Yip <4804085190@students.ocps.net>, Brandon Nova <4804241180@students.ocps.net>, Pari Vyas <4804150017@students.ocps.net>
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2024 21:57:05 -0500
Subject: story time (endgame edition ft. brandon collab)

The soothing breeze, whispers of leaves, and an eerily comfortable silence.
A flash of someone's eyes, and then none.

>From a towering stone building comes Lauren, having left after subduing
Olivia and outwitting Brandon. The rain is now a gentle pour, as she
continues her journey back home. Gianna rides on her shoulders as they
venture away from the prison, Natalie a fading memory.

In Tyler's house sits a beautiful dress- it's blue, as is representative of
his persona as indicated by the 2014 Erikson book. The clock strikes
midnight, and suddenly Tyler appears normally again. The dress is nowhere
to be seen. As it's another 4 hours until his bedtime, Tyler resumes
watching videos on how to fold hoodies.

On her way home Lauren is passing by a neighborhood. She deposits Gianna to
her home in a worm hole. Gianna shrinks down to the size of a beetle and
enters her worm hole. Lauren continues walking through the neighborhood.
The rain has slowed to a slight drizzle. Silence fills the air except for
the rustling of grass and the damp steps from Lauren's shoes. She notices a
slight movement from the corner of her eye. From a certain house out comes
Tyler, doing his daily walk at 3am.
"What are *you* doing here?" says Tyler. "This is my turf!"
"No, this is God's turf!" replies Lauren.

Lauren unsheathes her 24ft 14 karat gold sword. She uses the power of her
brain to materialize a wide 99.999% platinum shield. She lets out a sharp
shriek, and a lightning bolt bolts down from the sky, encasing her in a
blinding light. The light retreats, and Lauren is encased in full golden
body armor. She is literally on fire. Lauren is prepared to fight Tyler to
the death.

Tyler has no weapon.

Lauren raises her shield, points her sword at Tyler, and advances towards
him full force. She raises her sword to strike, and Tyler barely dives out
of the way. In the corner of his eye, Tyler sees a very long stick. The
perfect weapon. He just has to get to it first. Lauren swipes her sword
again, aiming for Tyler's head. Tyler rolls out of the way and quickly gets
on his feet. Lauren is blocking the way to the stick. How will he get
there? Tyler has an idea.
"Look! Natalie escaped from the prison!"
Lauren looks back. She is confused.
"What? No she didn't. I left her there."
Tyler sees his chance. He runs past Lauren, the stick just within reach.
But Lauren is too fast. She sees the stick and immediately sees what he is
trying to do. She throws her shield at Tyler and knocks him to the ground.
Lauren slowly approaches, sword raised. She swings her sword and strikes,
but the sword makes contact with the ground. Tyler has turned into a
beautiful blue dress. Lauren missed.

The dress transforms back into Tyler and he grabs the stick and swiftly
backs away. Lauren, enraged, is prepared to strike again. But just as she
raises her sword, it disappears. The fire around her swiftly fades away.
Her shield and armor dissolve into thin air.
Lauren is very confused. She looks at Tyler. "What happened?"
"This is some dark magic. It must be the work of a witch!" exclaims Tyler.
Immediately Lauren thinks of 1 person. She very dramatically turns to
Tyler, a serious look in her eye.
"Olivia." she says very seriously. "We need to find her and destroy her!"

Lauren and Tyler venture off into the forest. They go back to the worm hole
to search for Gianna. They call for Gianna, but nothing emerges from the
hole. Lauren has a brilliant idea, and pulls a piece of kimchi out of her
pocket. She lays the kimchi in front of the hole, planning to lure Gianna
out of the hole. It doesn't take long for Gianna to take the bait. A cute
little small beetle crawls out of the hole and turns into Gianna. They
explain their situation with the dark magic witch Olivia, and Gianna agrees
to help defeat her. But this isn't enough. They need more manpower, more
firepower, more willpower. Lauren has the perfect idea.

The heroic trio sprint their way through the forest, hurdling over fallen
tree trunks and dodging pesky bugs. Gianna occasionally stops to take a
nap, and Lauren has to lay a trail of kimchi so Gianna can catch up after
napping. After traveling for 3 days and 5 nights, the trio decides to make
camp. The sun is beginning to set, and soon darkness will be among them.
Gianna digs a nice hole for herself and nibbles on her last piece of
kimchi. She feels sleepy again, so she turns into a beetle and retreats
deeper into the hole. Tyler climbs a tree and rests on one of the branches.
He turns into a beautiful blue dress and hangs peacefully in the breeze.
Lauren reaches for her sword so she can cut down some fresh branches and
build shelter, but remembers that Olivia the Evil Sorcerer has dissolved
her sword. Lauren slowly lays down on the cold, hard ground and tries to
fall asleep.

A sweet, fruity smell fills the air as the sun's rays begin to peek through
the trees. Music dances past Lauren's ears as she hears the songs of birds
alongside the crisp crackling of a campfire. She looks over to see Tyler
and Gianna resting beside the fire, cooking mysterious red berries.
"Are you sure we can eat those?" questioned Lauren.
Tyler gives her a quizzical look as if this is common knowledge. "Yes, all
mysterious berries are safe to eat."
Lauren does not question Tyler's judgement. Gianna has already eaten
several berries (in beetle form). Lauren grabs a berry off the fire and
plops it in her mouth. The taste is immaculate. She takes possession of all
the berries and downs them all in no more than 5 seconds.
"Alright, let's continue!" exclaims Lauren. The three get up and continue
their journey through the forest. Tyler is sad because he didn't get to eat
any mysterious berries.

The triumphant trio find themselves back at the large stone prison. The
serious guard stands in front, performing his job very seriously. Lauren
makes her way across the moat and confidently approaches the guard.
"We need your help!" Lauren exclaims.
"Sure, I will help!" responds Brandon the Guard. Brandon closes the gate to
the prison, fully prepared to leave his post and help the group. They
desperately need him and he knows it. Brandon will provide the best
willpower to the group. The ferocious four run into the distance, prepared
to bring Olivia down once and for all.

~~ intermission ~~

The four reach the edges of the forest, seeing a large metropolis on the
horizon. A massive cloud looms over the whole city. It is moving slowly,
ominously, in a large spiral. In the center of the spiral, a large
skyscraper reaches up. That is Olivia's fortress. This is where the four
must venture.
Gianna has an undying urge to eat chicken wings. The city is so close- all
they have to do is make a pit stop. Gianna voices her concerns to the
group. "I'm hungry :(" Everyone turns to Gianna and thinks for a bit. They
decide that they need someone to scout out the area anyway, otherwise
they'll be going into the battlefield blind. Tyler volunteers to go map out
the tower and the area around it so he can formulate a plan while the
others get chicken wings. He is very hungry, but he is also still salty
about Lauren eating all the berries. He needs time to cool down.
Tyler turns into a dress and moves like a flying carpet off into the
distance. He is a very stealthy scout. The others venture to another part
of the city in search of chicken wings.


7 hours later, the four regroup at the chicken wing place. Gianna, Lauren,
and Brandon are very satisfied and full with chicken wings. Tyler is
satisfied with a job well done in scouting out Olivia's palace, but he
comes with urgent news. Natalie is being held prisoner in Olivia's tower.
They must formulate a plan to save her!
"What?! Do we have to?" exclaimed Lauren. "She'll be fine."
The others disagree. They must rescue her! They swiftly head out, ready to
stop Olivia once and for all.

The big city skyline looms over everyone. A tense uneasiness over the
population, rumors of some pending crisis, the uneasiness of the current
calm. Natalie is held hostage at the top of 200 Park Ave 10166, and Tyler,
Lauren, and Gianna stand at the bottom, on the road leading from Grand
central station. Brandon quickly goes to the top to try to free Natalie,
but is stopped suddenly. Olivia stands in front of him. "Stop",  she says.
Brandon stops, then immediately runs to save Natalie, "You didn't say how
long". Olivia tackles him violently and puts him in a cage seperate to
Natalie (covid 19 social distancing). Unable to see because it's far away
and two thirds of them are borderline blind Tyler, Lauren, and Gianna stand
at the bottom trying to figure out what to do next.

The tremendous trio bolt up the stairs. They stand face to face with
Olivia, her sorceress staff at the ready. Lauren runs around in circles,
aiming to distract Olivia. Tyler turns into a flying dress and also travels
in circles, also aiming to distract Olivia. Gianna transforms into a
beetle, swiftly enters Brandon's cage, and unlocks it. Brandon begins
shouting words of encouragement as Lauren and Olivia engage in hand-to-hand
combat.
"Give me back my 24ft 14 karat gold sword!" demanded Lauren.
"Never!" politely responded Olivia.

Gianna (still in beetle form) stealthily and swiftly approaches Olivia as
she continues to 1-on-1 battle Lauren. Brandon continues to provide
excellent willpower, and Tyler continues to fly in circles, creating giant
gusts of wind. Lauren kicks Olivia, then grabs Olivia's arm and judo-flips
her over her shoulder. Lauren pins Olivia's shoulders to the ground. She is
trapped. Olivia slowly grabs her staff, ready to unleash a powerful spell.
But just then- SWOOSH! Gianna the Beetle flies through the air and lands in
Olivia's eye.
"AAAHH! A BEETLE!!!" Olivia calmly proclaimed. "Fine! I surrender!"

Lauren helps Olivia up. "SIKE!" Olivia suddenly whips out her staff and
smacks Lauren in the stomach. The battle continues. Brandon is now shouting
even more encouraging words of encouragement, and Tyler speeds up his
circles. Gianna turns back into human form.
"Stop! Can't we all be friends?"
Olivia and Lauren stop fighting for a second. They ponder this for a moment.
"Yes, we should be friends," Olivia says.
Everyone stops fighting and groups together in the center of the room.
Tyler turns back into human form, the winds still blowing in circles.
Lauren, Gianna, Brandon, Tyler, and Olivia all do a group hug. Their issue
is resolved, and Olivia will no longer be an evil sorceress. Hurrah!

Just then Brandon looks back and sees something frightening. A giant
tornado has formed in the room during their group hug. Tyler flew too fast!
The ground begins to rumble, the ceiling cracking and shaking. The building
is going to collapse! The ferocious four quickly make their way out of the
tower. As soon as they reach the ground, pieces of the tower begin hitting
the ground. A sinkhole forms as the tower caves in on itself. Luckily, all
the main characters made it out safely.

*Final scene where olivia is a good guy*

*Everyone hugs and is friends*

The end. Remember to Never Eat Soggy Waffles.

Subject: story time (night time edition)

The silence is hauntingly peaceful. Darkness cloaks him like a warm
blanket. Tyler is sitting in his house at 3 am, studying intently on how to
perfectly fold a hoodie. Dozens of tabs open, running 2 videos at the same
time, reading articles, Tyler is working so hard to master this craft.

 EERRRREEEECCCHH!

 Tyler looks up and surveys the room. Where did that sound come from? Oh
well. Maybe he’s stayed up too late and is hallucinating. Whatever- he must
continue his studies. Tyler pulls up another video on how to fold hoodies.


“I wouldn’t do that if I were you.”

 Tyler looks around again. Who said that? Where did it come from? The voice
sounds eerily like Lauren, but Lauren is nowhere to be seen. Just then, a
floating hoodie drifts into the room.

 “You can’t learn how to fold hoodies. They deserve to be free, not
constricted as so!” said the hoodie.
“Lauren, is that you?” questioned Tyler.
“Yes. I have been trapped inside this hoodie. You have to save me!”

 Tyler feels a sudden sense of urgency. He must save Lauren from the
clutches of the hoodie! He knows just where to start. Tyler opens his
window and jumps out, running towards the lake.

 The cold air brushes past his face as he runs faster and faster towards
the lake. But he is suddenly stopped by Gianna. She has a look of pure
horror on her face.
“You can’t go there! I’ve already tried to save Lauren. There is no point”
exclaimed Gianna. Tyler, confused, tries to figure out why. Gianna swiftly
turns into a hat. This is not good.

 Tyler is determined to save the day, so he continues towards the Lake.
Finally he makes it to the lake, and feels the cool mist blowing against
his face. In the middle of the lake sits Olivia, floating and meditating
over the surface of the water. She warns Tyler not to come any closer, but
Tyler has to save his friends.
“Turn them back into people!” demanded Tyler. “no” proclaimed Olivia very
seriously.

 Tyler begins running on the water. He will do whatever it takes to stop
this madness. Suddenly, Olivia pulls out a magic wand and points it at
Tyler. He realizes too late that he is her next target.

 “NOOOOOOO!” Brandon flies across the water, blocking the hit from the
magic wand.
“Brandon, you sacrificed yourself for me?” asked Tyler. Brandon lies on the
surface of the water, barely breathing.
“I know you would do the same for me” replied Brandon very dramatically.
 “No Brandon! Stay with me!”

 Brandon swiftly transforms into a pair of shoes. Before Tyler can fully
register the weight of this sacrifice, Olivia points the wand at him again.
Tyler, still in shock, has no time to react. He faces the magic of her
wand, and is turned into a beautiful dress. Olivia has won again.

The end.

AP Physics 1 Test Information - DO NOT DELETE!
From: "Newcomer, Amanda H." <amanda.newcomer@ocps.net>
To: "4804241180@students.ocps.net" <4804241180@students.ocps.net>
Date: Thu, 09 May 2024 12:58:31 +0000
Labels: Inbox, Important, Opened, Category Personal
Message-ID: <SA1PR01MB726165723A495D9227476E7286E62@SA1PR01MB7261.prod.exchangelabs.com>

Dear Brandon Nova,
Listed below is part or all of your exam schedule. If you are taking multiple exams, you will receive multiple emails.  Please review each carefully for accuracy. If you see any discrepancies, please contact me immediately.
AP Exam
Date
Student Arrival Time
Room Number
AP Physics 1
Friday, May 17
7:30:00 AM
Media Center

As a reminder, a parent or guardian MUST have completed the Google Form for you to leave campus after your morning exam.  If it has not been completed, you will return to class.
Below is information for the AP Exams for May 2024.  Please review ALL information carefully.
MOST afternoon AP exams end AFTER school ends (2:20).  Please ensure you have adequate transportation after your exam ends, as transportation is NOT provided.  You CANNOT be released from your exam early to ride a bus.
If you are testing in the GYM, we have found it to be VERY chilly as of late.  Please bring a jacket or sweatshirt to keep warm.
Before exam day:

  *   You will receive an email with your testing location.  Please check the location CAREFULLY.

*         You are required to arrive no later than 30 minutes prior to your exam: 7:30 a.m. for the morning administration and 11:30 a.m. for the afternoon administration. Students may not be dismissed until an exam has officially ended; do not ask to leave early if you finish before the end of the exam. If you play a sport or have a job, it is your responsibility to inform your coach or employer of your AP Exam obligation, and arrangements should be made accordingly.

*         If you have an AFTERNOON exam on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday or Friday, please go to A Lunch.  If you have an AFTERNOON exam on Wednesday, please go to your NORMAL lunch.
Be sure to bring these:

  *   No. 2 pencils for your multiple-choice answer sheet.
  *   Pens with black or dark blue ink for completing areas on the exam booklet covers and for free-response questions in most exams.
  *   Up to two approved calculators with the necessary capabilities if you're taking an AP Biology, Calculus, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Macroeconomics, Microeconomics, Physics or Statistics Exam. Visit THIS LINK<https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/exam-policies-guidelines/calculator-policies> to learn more about the calculator policy for each of these exams and for a list of authorized calculators.
  *   A current government-issued or school-issued photo ID. (Additional ID may be required by authorized test centers outside the United States.)
     *   Windermere Students: your WHS ID is sufficient.  The one on your phone is fine, but your phone MUST be turned off immediately after your ID has been checked.
  *   Your College Board SSD Accommodations Letter if you are taking an exam with approved testing accommodations.
  *   A watch that does not have internet access, does not beep or make noise and does not have an alarm.
  *   A ruler or straight edge ONLY if you are taking an AP Physics Exam.  Protractors are NOT allowed.
Don't bring these:

  *   Electronic equipment including phones, smartwatches, fitness trackers, wearable technology, cameras, recording or listening devices, or any other type of electronic or communication device.
     *   The only exceptions to the above restrictions are laptops or other devices specifically permitted to be used for in-school digital testing.
     *   School-owned and school-controlled digital recording devices are allowed only for the AP French, AP German, AP Italian, and AP Spanish Language and Culture Exams, and the AP Music Theory Exam.
  *   Books, reference guides, notes, compasses, protractors, mechanical pencils, pencils that are not No. 2, correction fluid, dictionaries, highlighters, or colored pencils.
  *   Scratch paper: Students testing in-school are prohibited from bringing scratch paper to the AP Exam, but scratch paper will be provided.
  *   Watches that beep, make a noise, or have an alarm.
  *   Computers or calculators that are not approved.
  *   Reference guides, keyboard maps, or other typing instructions.
  *   Ear plugs
  *   Earbuds
  *   Clothing or shoes with subject-related information.
  *   Food or drink (EXCEPTION - if you have multiple tests in one day, you may bring snacks to keep in your bag for between exams).
  *   Clipboards
A student observed with any of these prohibited items during testing or breaks may be dismissed from the exam, the device may be confiscated, the student's score may be canceled, and no retest may be permitted.

Details about required and prohibited items are in the AP Exam Terms and Conditions<https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/exam-policies-guidelines/terms-conditions>.
Should you have any questions, please contact me directly.
Amanda Newcomer, M. Ed.
AP Coordinator
AICE Coordinator
Windermere High School

AP English Literature Information - DO NOT DELETE!
From: "Newcomer, Amanda H." <amanda.newcomer@ocps.net>
To: "4804241180@students.ocps.net" <4804241180@students.ocps.net>
Date: Mon, 06 May 2024 12:35:38 +0000
Labels: Important, Trash, Opened, Category Personal
Message-ID: <SA1PR01MB726163D3DD6118F43010613C861C2@SA1PR01MB7261.prod.exchangelabs.com>

Dear Brandon Nova,
Listed below is part or all of your exam schedule. If you are taking multiple exams, you will receive multiple emails.  Please review each carefully for accuracy. If you see any discrepancies, please contact me immediately.
AP Exam
Date
Student Arrival Time
Room Number
AP English Literature and Composition
Wednesday, May 8th
7:30:00 AM
Gym

As a reminder, a parent or guardian MUST have completed the Google Form for you to leave campus after your morning exam.  If it has not been completed, you will return to class.
Below is information for the AP Exams for May 2024.  Please review ALL information carefully.
MOST afternoon AP exams end AFTER school ends (2:20).  Please ensure you have adequate transportation after your exam ends, as transportation is NOT provided.  You CANNOT be released from your exam early to ride a bus.
If you are testing in the GYM, we have found it to be VERY chilly as of late.  Please bring a jacket or sweatshirt to keep warm.
Before exam day:

  *   You will receive an email with your testing location.  Please check the location CAREFULLY.

*         You are required to arrive no later than 30 minutes prior to your exam: 7:30 a.m. for the morning administration and 11:30 a.m. for the afternoon administration. Students may not be dismissed until an exam has officially ended; do not ask to leave early if you finish before the end of the exam. If you play a sport or have a job, it is your responsibility to inform your coach or employer of your AP Exam obligation, and arrangements should be made accordingly.

*         If you have an AFTERNOON exam on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday or Friday, please go to A Lunch.  If you have an AFTERNOON exam on Wednesday, please go to your NORMAL lunch.
Be sure to bring these:

  *   No. 2 pencils for your multiple-choice answer sheet.
  *   Pens with black or dark blue ink for completing areas on the exam booklet covers and for free-response questions in most exams.
  *   Up to two approved calculators with the necessary capabilities if you're taking an AP Biology, Calculus, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Macroeconomics, Microeconomics, Physics or Statistics Exam. Visit THIS LINK<https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/exam-policies-guidelines/calculator-policies> to learn more about the calculator policy for each of these exams and for a list of authorized calculators.
  *   A current government-issued or school-issued photo ID. (Additional ID may be required by authorized test centers outside the United States.)
     *   Windermere Students: your WHS ID is sufficient.  The one on your phone is fine, but your phone MUST be turned off immediately after your ID has been checked.
  *   Your College Board SSD Accommodations Letter if you are taking an exam with approved testing accommodations.
  *   A watch that does not have internet access, does not beep or make noise and does not have an alarm.
  *   A ruler or straight edge ONLY if you are taking an AP Physics Exam.  Protractors are NOT allowed.
Don't bring these:

  *   Electronic equipment including phones, smartwatches, fitness trackers, wearable technology, cameras, recording or listening devices, or any other type of electronic or communication device.
     *   The only exceptions to the above restrictions are laptops or other devices specifically permitted to be used for in-school digital testing.
     *   School-owned and school-controlled digital recording devices are allowed only for the AP French, AP German, AP Italian, and AP Spanish Language and Culture Exams, and the AP Music Theory Exam.
  *   Books, reference guides, notes, compasses, protractors, mechanical pencils, pencils that are not No. 2, correction fluid, dictionaries, highlighters, or colored pencils.
  *   Scratch paper: Students testing in-school are prohibited from bringing scratch paper to the AP Exam, but scratch paper will be provided.
  *   Watches that beep, make a noise, or have an alarm.
  *   Computers or calculators that are not approved.
  *   Reference guides, keyboard maps, or other typing instructions.
  *   Ear plugs
  *   Earbuds
  *   Clothing or shoes with subject-related information.
  *   Food or drink (EXCEPTION - if you have multiple tests in one day, you may bring snacks to keep in your bag for between exams).
  *   Clipboards
A student observed with any of these prohibited items during testing or breaks may be dismissed from the exam, the device may be confiscated, the student's score may be canceled, and no retest may be permitted.

Details about required and prohibited items are in the AP Exam Terms and Conditions<https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/exam-policies-guidelines/terms-conditions>.
Should you have any questions, please contact me directly.
Amanda Newcomer, M. Ed.
AP Coordinator
AICE Coordinator
Windermere High School

Dear Brandon Nova,
Listed below is part or all of your exam schedule. If you are taking multiple exams, you will receive multiple emails.  Please review each carefully for accuracy. If you see any discrepancies, please contact me immediately.

Media Center

As a reminder, a parent or guardian MUST have completed the Google Form for you to leave campus after your morning exam.  If it has not been completed, you will return to class.
Below is information for the AP Exams for May 2024.  Please review ALL information carefully.
MOST afternoon AP exams end AFTER school ends (2:20).  Please ensure you have adequate transportation after your exam ends, as transportation is NOT provided.  You CANNOT be released from your exam early to ride a bus.
If you are testing in the GYM, we have found it to be VERY chilly as of late.  Please bring a jacket or sweatshirt to keep warm.
Before exam day:

  *   You will receive an email with your testing location.  Please check the location CAREFULLY.

*         You are required to arrive no later than 30 minutes prior to your exam: 7:30 a.m. for the morning administration and 11:30 a.m. for the afternoon administration. Students may not be dismissed until an exam has officially ended; do not ask to leave early if you finish before the end of the exam. If you play a sport or have a job, it is your responsibility to inform your coach or employer of your AP Exam obligation, and arrangements should be made accordingly.

*         If you have an AFTERNOON exam on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday or Friday, please go to A Lunch.  If you have an AFTERNOON exam on Wednesday, please go to your NORMAL lunch.
Be sure to bring these:

  *   No. 2 pencils for your multiple-choice answer sheet.
  *   Pens with black or dark blue ink for completing areas on the exam booklet covers and for free-response questions in most exams.
  *   Up to two approved calculators with the necessary capabilities if you're taking an AP Biology, Calculus, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Macroeconomics, Microeconomics, Physics or Statistics Exam. Visit THIS LINK<https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/exam-policies-guidelines/calculator-policies> to learn more about the calculator policy for each of these exams and for a list of authorized calculators.
  *   A current government-issued or school-issued photo ID. (Additional ID may be required by authorized test centers outside the United States.)
     *   Windermere Students: your WHS ID is sufficient.  The one on your phone is fine, but your phone MUST be turned off immediately after your ID has been checked.
  *   Your College Board SSD Accommodations Letter if you are taking an exam with approved testing accommodations.
  *   A watch that does not have internet access, does not beep or make noise and does not have an alarm.
  *   A ruler or straight edge ONLY if you are taking an AP Physics Exam.  Protractors are NOT allowed.
Don't bring these:

  *   Electronic equipment including phones, smartwatches, fitness trackers, wearable technology, cameras, recording or listening devices, or any other type of electronic or communication device.
     *   The only exceptions to the above restrictions are laptops or other devices specifically permitted to be used for in-school digital testing.
     *   School-owned and school-controlled digital recording devices are allowed only for the AP French, AP German, AP Italian, and AP Spanish Language and Culture Exams, and the AP Music Theory Exam.
  *   Books, reference guides, notes, compasses, protractors, mechanical pencils, pencils that are not No. 2, correction fluid, dictionaries, highlighters, or colored pencils.
  *   Scratch paper: Students testing in-school are prohibited from bringing scratch paper to the AP Exam, but scratch paper will be provided.
  *   Watches that beep, make a noise, or have an alarm.
  *   Computers or calculators that are not approved.
  *   Reference guides, keyboard maps, or other typing instructions.
  *   Ear plugs
  *   Earbuds
  *   Clothing or shoes with subject-related information.
  *   Food or drink (EXCEPTION - if you have multiple tests in one day, you may bring snacks to keep in your bag for between exams).
  *   Clipboards
A student observed with any of these prohibited items during testing or breaks may be dismissed from the exam, the device may be confiscated, the student's score may be canceled, and no retest may be permitted.

Details about required and prohibited items are in the AP Exam Terms and Conditions<https://apstudents.collegeboard.org/exam-policies-guidelines/terms-conditions>.
Should you have any questions, please contact me directly.
Amanda Newcomer, M. Ed.

Hi Wolverines!

This is your email with everything you should need to know regarding Prom 2024! Everything is covered on the graphics below and posted on the SGA Instagram ( @ocps_whs_sga ), but here's a recap of the information given:


  1.  Parking
     *   Everyone attending should have the Gate Tag (Attached) to show at the gate. (Please share with bus/ limo drivers)

                                                               i.      If being dropped off (bus, limo, parent, etc) you will be dropped off in the bus loop

                                                             ii.      If self parking, you will park in the lot and walk or be shuttled down to the bus loop

     *   PLEASE DO NOT ATTEMPT TO COME THROUGH THE MAIN HOTEL LOBBY



  1.  Food at Prom
     *   A menu of the buffet style food served at the event is attached with gluten free and vegetarian options noted
     *   Please note that food will be out from 7:30-9:30 PM only



  1.  Doors/ Arrival Time
     *   Doors/ entry for the event will end at 8:30 PM
     *   To enter the event, you need Photo ID and your QR Code from Teach Tix (Make sure we can see your name below the QR Code)
     *   Guests must enter with their host



  1.  Prom King and Queen Ceremony
     *   The crowing ceremony will take place at 9:30 PM
     *   Attendees will be allowed to vote as they enter the event



  1.  Souvenir Key Chains
     *   If you have not already, you can stop by the SGA Room to pick up your souvenir keychain
     *   You do not need this for entry, it is just a keepsake for your memories

If you have any additional questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out!

Reminder: Prom Ticket Sales Close Tomorrow! (Friday 4/12)
From: "Brengel, Evan N." <Evan.Brengel@ocps.net>

Hey Wolverines

Just a few fast reminders:


  1.  If you haven't bought your ticket yet for Prom 2024, ticket sales close tomorrow (Friday 4/12)



  1.  If you have bought your ticket, you can pick up your souvenir keychain at the SGA Room (Not required for entry, just a gift for you)



  1.  Reminders about event parking, bus/limo drop off, food, arrival times and Prom King and Queen ceremony will be sent to your email and posted to the SGA Instagram-make sure you're following! (@ocps_whs_sga)



If you need a copy of the directions to purchase, please find them below--- and get excited!





Please note that if you fail to maintain compliance with all the posted requirements, your ability to attend may be in jeopardy,  and your ticket may be invalidated.


Directions to Purchase

  1.  You may purchase your ticket at this Link to Buy Ticket:  www.teachtix.com/whs/prom-2024<http://www.teachtix.com/whs/prom-2024>


  1.  When you click the link, scroll down and click the graphic to enter the sales for our event.



  1.  Select ONE Standard ticket and click "Add to Cart"



     *   Note: You will ONLY be able to purchase one, even though the drop down option exists to select a higher quantity



  1.  Choose the ticket type--- WHS Student
     *   Note: You will not be able to purchase a Guest ticket at this time. If you attempt to select Guest ticket, it will say "Student ID Not Recognized"



  1.  Answer the pop up questions



  1.  Continue to checkout.



  1.  Place your first name, last name and student email address. Double check your email address--this is where your ticket goes.



  1.  Complete the acknowledgements



  1.  Click Process Order



  1.  Your ticket will be emailed to you with a scannable QR code.



  1.  We recommend taking a screenshot of the QR code.


     *   When you enter the event, you must get your QR code scanned. This link is only scannable ONCE!
     *   If you leave the event, you will NOT be able to re-enter.
     *   If you pass your QR code (which has your name on it) to anyone else, your link will be flagged/ invalidated.





  1.  To enter the event, you will need:
     *   QR Code Ticket Screenshot or Printout
     *   Physical ID-Student ID Preferred (Get in faster) or license



  1.  Any relevant Information will be released via the SGA Instagram.

Other Notes:


  1.  Souvenir Keychain
     *   Your ticket prices includes a complimentary keychain (shown in the photo attached to this email)
     *   You can stop by the SGA room to pickup any day Mr. Brengel is present with proof of purchase!
     *   If you purchase a guest ticket, you can get one for your guest as well!


  1.  Guest Forms
     *   Guest forms are available in the SGA Room (7-102) and due by Friday April 5th at the latest
     *   If you have submitted a guest form, give approximately 48 hours for it to be reviewed and approved or denied
     *   If cleared, you will be contacted via email with the link to purchase an instructions similar to this.
     *   If there is an issues, you will be contacted via email with the status of the issue.



  1.  Final Reminders
     *   Once you have purchased a ticket, you can come to the SGA room to pick up a souvenir keychain (Not required for entry, just a gift!)
     *   Arrive to the Event before 8:30 PM on Saturday April 20th .
     *   Please adhere to the posted dress code
     *   Arrival ends at 8:30PM. Late arrivals may be denied admittance.
     *   No bags are permitted. A small clutch is fine, but it and all pockets are subject to turnout/ search.

Please do not hesitate to reach out with any additional questions or concerns.

Talented Twenty Information
From: "Granberry, Keyonata L." <Keyonata.Granberry@ocps.net>

Labels: Archived, Important, Opened, Category Personal, Important Inforation

[Windermere High School  5523 Winter Garden Vineland Road * Windermere, FL 34786][cid:image004.jpg@01DA8041.85C91B70]










March 27, 2024





Dear Nova, Brandon T.:



Congratulations on your significant academic accomplishments! Given that you have been ranked in the top 20 percent of your graduating class, you may be eligible to secure guaranteed admission to one of the 12 state universities, within space and fiscal limitations, through Florida's Talented Twenty program. You must meet the following Talented Twenty eligibility criteria below:



*        Enrolled in a Florida public high school and graduate with a standard diploma;

*        Ranked in the top 20 percent of your class after the posting of the seventh semester grades of your final high school year;

*        Submitted test scores from the Scholastic Aptitude Test (SAT) Reasoning Test or redesigned SAT scores from the College Board or the ACT from ACT.org prior to enrollment in a university in the State University System (SUS).

*        Completed all eighteen high school units as listed in the Board of Governors Regulation 6.002.



Talented Twenty students are also given priority in the awarding of funds from the Florida Student Assistance Grant, a need-based grant. This is only possible if students apply prior to financial awards being distributed. Please visit http://www.FloridaStudentFinancialAid.org<http://www.FloridaStudentFinancialAid.org/> for eligibility requirements and additional information on state financial aid and scholarship opportunities.



Please note that while eligible students are guaranteed admission to one of Florida's state universities, within space and fiscal limitations, they may not necessarily be admitted to the university of their choice. Students are required to apply to at least three state universities prior to seeking a special review. Students are strongly encouraged to apply as early as possible in order to have the most options available to them. Additional information, including responses to frequently asked questions regarding the Talented Twenty program, is available online at https://www.fldoe.org/schools/family-community/activities-programs/pre<http://www.fldoe.org/schools/family-community/activities-programs/pre> collegiate/talented-twenty-program/.









[cid:image006.jpg@01DA8041.85C91B70]

Sincerely,

Keyonata Granberry

Keyonata Granberry

School Counselor

Windermere High School

> The bell rings. Macroeconomics class is over. That test was a breeze. I
> head down the stairs and make my way to my usual lunch spot. I make camp
> and begin my routine: pull out the laptop, find music to listen to (today
> is rock + Bruno Mars), pull out lunch. I have prepared for myself a
> delightful lunch of Jozef's leftovers from Chipotle (he doesn't know I took
> them- that's okay).
>
> crap.
>
> I forgot to bring a utensil. Silly me! This morning I remember making a
> note to put a spoon in my lunchbox. I would put the spoon in after eating
> breakfast.
>
> I did not put the spoon in after breakfast.
>
> I turn off my music and place my laptop back in my backpack. I put my
> lunch back in my lunchbox, and very neatly place my belongings against the
> wall. Now begins the quest to find a spoon.
>
> How much time can I leave my stuff unattended before someone notices it?
> For how long will it stay before an administrator removes my belongings? I
> must return before then. I run out into the blistering sun, devoted to
> being quick and speedy. I run faster than any man before me. I run as fast
> as the speed of light. I am a photon (except I have mass, and therefore I
> have momentum and we can use the p = mv equation).
>
> I almost make it to the cafeteria door when suddenly a giant Leftakis
> blocks my path. "Use the other door!" No! I was so close! I run to the
> other door and make my way to the lunch line. I jump over pedestrians and
> push them out of my way. I must get the spoon. I finally make my way to the
> front, but alas, they only have forks. Was all this for nothing?
>
> I grab a fork and make my way back to my spot. My things are still there,
> waiting patiently for me. I resume my routine. I take out my laptop, pull
> up some music. I take out my lunch, now having a fork, and eat Jozef's
> Chipotle leftovers. I open Gmail and begin to recount my adventures.
>
> The end.
>

the quest (historical fiction)
From: Natalie Miesak <4804135947@students.ocps.net>
To: Tyler Szydlo <4804136151@students.ocps.net>, Brandon Nova <4804241180@students.ocps.net>, Lauren Willman <4804089800@students.ocps.net>, Olivia Yip <4804085190@students.ocps.net>, Gianna Kim <4804135863@students.ocps.net>, Pari Vyas <4804150017@students.ocps.net>
Date: Fri, 08 Mar 2024 12:23:08 -0500
Labels: Archived, Important, Opened, Category Personal, MEMORIES ARCHIVE
Message-ID: <CAGZ_XgAFqJ1AGKCLOepxfWQnD39VG8_69eq2Yursw-KbKv+Qhg@mail.gmail.com>

The bell rings. Macroeconomics class is over. That test was a breeze. I
head down the stairs and make my way to my usual lunch spot. I make camp
and begin my routine: pull out the laptop, find music to listen to (today
is rock + Bruno Mars), pull out lunch. I have prepared for myself a
delightful lunch of Jozef's leftovers from Chipotle (he doesn't know I took
them- that's okay).

crap.

I forgot to bring a utensil. Silly me! This morning I remember making a
note to put a spoon in my lunchbox. I would put the spoon in after eating
breakfast.

I did not put the spoon in after breakfast.

I turn off my music and place my laptop back in my backpack. I put my lunch
back in my lunchbox, and very neatly place my belongings against the wall.
Now begins the quest to find a spoon.

How much time can I leave my stuff unattended before someone notices it?
For how long will it stay before an administrator removes my belongings? I
must return before then. I run out into the blistering sun, devoted to
being quick and speedy. I run faster than any man before me. I run as fast
as the speed of light. I am a photon (except I have mass, and therefore I
have momentum and we can use the p = mv equation).

I almost make it to the cafeteria door when suddenly a giant Leftakis
blocks my path. "Use the other door!" No! I was so close! I run to the
other door and make my way to the lunch line. I jump over pedestrians and
push them out of my way. I must get the spoon. I finally make my way to the
front, but alas, they only have forks. Was all this for nothing?

I grab a fork and make my way back to my spot. My things are still there,
waiting patiently for me. I resume my routine. I take out my laptop, pull
up some music. I take out my lunch, now having a fork, and eat Jozef's
Chipotle leftovers. I open Gmail and begin to recount my adventures.

The end.

the funky fish flops on the floor
using all its energy
to get to the door.

the door.
the door.

what lies beyond the door?

perhaps the fish could explore
and learn so much more.
inch by inch
the fish
approaches the door.

no water
no food
no air
only the floor

if only the fish
could get to the door.

"the door" is a much more suitable subject lol

  1.  Click Process Order

  1.  We recommend taking a screenshot of the QR code.

     *   If you leave the event, you will NOT be able to re-enter.
     *   If you pass your QR code (which has your name on it) to anyone else, your link will be flagged/ invalidated.





  1.  To enter the event, you will need:
     *   QR Code Ticket Screenshot or Printout
     *   Physical ID-Student ID Preferred (Get in faster) or license



  1.  Any relevant Information will be released via the SGA Instagram.

     *   If you have submitted a guest form, give approximately 48 hours for it to be reviewed and approved or denied
     *   If cleared, you will be contacted via email with the link to purchase an instructions similar to this.
     *   If there is an issues, you will be contacted via email with the status of the issue.



  1.  Final Reminders
     *   Once you have purchased a ticket, you can come to the SGA room to pick up a souvenir keychain (Not required for entry, just a gift!)
     *   Arrive to the Event before 8:30 PM on Saturday April 20th .
     *   Please adhere to the posted dress code
     *   Arrival ends at 8:30PM. Late arrivals may be denied admittance.
     *   No bags are permitted. A small clutch is fine, but it and all pockets are subject to turnout/ search.

Please do not hesitate to reach out with any additional questions or concerns.

*once upon a time...*

there was a *very cool* dog 🐕 that lived in the *mountains* ⛰️. every day,
the dog would *TREK* to the bottom of the mountain to collect fresh water
for its swimming pool 🌊🚿, then hike back up to the top of the mountain so
it could *enjoy* the swimming pool. the dog was running down the mountain *very
fast*, holding the bucket in its paws 🐾. he scooped up some water from the
waterfall at the bottom, then ran back up to the top of the mountain. he
*poured* the water into his swimming hole.

the dog *ran back down the mountain* and got some more water then brought
it to the top. the dog did this multiple times until the swimming hole
was *nice
and full*. by this point, the sun was beginning to set 🌄. the dog had a *nice
snack* of some fresh green grass 🥬, then swam in the pool for about* 5
minutes*. the sun had set *now*, so the dog drained the pool 🕳️.

the dog *slept* at the bottom of the empty pool, ready to get a good
night's rest and *do it all again tomorrow*. 🎑

the end

Prom 2024-- Approved to Purchase a Ticket!
From: "Brengel, Evan N." <Evan.Brengel@ocps.net>

Good Day Wolverine,

Congratulations, you have met the requirements for Pre-Clearance for Prom 2024. Sales do not start until March 4th for Seniors

Please note that if you fail to maintain compliance with all the posted requirements, your ability to attend may be in jeopardy,  and your ticket may be invalidated.


Directions to Purchase

  1.  You may purchase your ticket at this Link to Buy Ticket:  www.teachtix.com/whs/prom-2024<http://www.teachtix.com/whs/prom-2024>


  1.  When you click the link, scroll down and click the graphic to enter the sales for our event.



  1.  Select ONE Standard ticket and click "Add to Cart"



     *   Note: You will ONLY be able to purchase one, even though the drop down option exists to select a higher quantity



  1.  Choose the ticket type--- WHS Student
     *   Note: You will not be able to purchase a Guest ticket at this time. If you attempt to select Guest ticket, it will say "Student ID Not Recognized"



  1.  Answer the pop up questions



  1.  Continue to checkout.



  1.  Place your first name, last name and student email address. Double check your email address--this is where your ticket goes.



  1.  Complete the acknowledgements



  1.  Click Process Order



  1.  Your ticket will be emailed to you with a scannable QR code.



  1.  We recommend taking a screenshot of the QR code.


     *   When you enter the event, you must get your QR code scanned. This link is only scannable ONCE!
     *   If you leave the event, you will NOT be able to re-enter.
     *   If you pass your QR code (which has your name on it) to anyone else, your link will be flagged/ invalidated.





  1.  To enter the event, you will need:
     *   QR Code Ticket Screenshot or Printout
     *   Physical ID-Student ID Preferred (Get in faster) or license



  1.  Any relevant Information will be released via the SGA Instagram.

Other Notes:


  1.  Guest Forms
     *   Guest forms are available in the SGA Room (7-102) and due by Friday April 5th at the latest
     *   If you have submitted a guest form, give approximately 48 hours for it to be reviewed and approved or denied
     *   If cleared, you will be contacted via email with the link to purchase an instructions similar to this.
     *   If there is an issues, you will be contacted via email with the status of the issue.



  1.  Final Reminders
     *   Once you have purchased a ticket, you can come to the SGA room to pick up a souvenir keychain (Not required for entry, just a gift!)
     *   Arrive to the Event before 8:30 PM on Saturday April 20th .
     *   Please adhere to the posted dress code
     *   Arrival ends at 8:30PM. Late arrivals may be denied admittance.
     *   No bags are permitted. A small clutch is fine, but it and all pockets are subject to turnout/ search.

Please do not hesitate to reach out with any additional questions or concerns.

Evan N. Brengel
Student Government Association Advisor/ Instructor
Windermere High School
Home of the WOLVERINES
"This is our destiny, our legacy, and our time is now."

the alley (storytime)
From: Natalie Miesak <4804135947@students.ocps.net>
To: Tyler Szydlo <4804136151@students.ocps.net>, Brandon Nova <4804241180@students.ocps.net>, Lauren Willman <4804089800@students.ocps.net>, Olivia Yip <4804085190@students.ocps.net>, Gianna Kim <4804135863@students.ocps.net>, Pari Vyas <4804150017@students.ocps.net>
Date: Tue, 27 Feb 2024 10:38:31 -0500
Labels: Archived, Important, Opened, Category Personal, MEMORIES ARCHIVE
Message-ID: <CAGZ_XgDU8NQXygigPS1WkcT66P2es4bJcwY9V7uk3OvVRO3rpg@mail.gmail.com>

he holds a pencil the size of a baseball bat. he writes in his little
notebook, but who knows what he writes? if anyone tries to see, he turns
away. he hides his writing. *no, this is private.* no one can know what
goes on in his head.

he is dressed completely in black- a black long-sleeve turtleneck with
black pants. he sits in the back corner of the library, a small table and
chair, hidden among the aisles of bookshelves. he is writing with his
prized giant pencil and tiny notebook. it is well past sundown- a black
void beyond the windows, dimly lit light inside the library. the clock
strikes 10. the library is closed. it's time to go. he slips his notebook
in his pocket and pulls on his long, black trenchcoat. he places a black
fedora on his head and slings his pencil over his shoulder, strapped to his
back.

he swiftly leaves the library, making no sound. his movements are smooth as
a ghost as he makes his way down the street. pedestrians give him space as
he passes by, emitting an unsettling aura. he discretely checks his
surroundings before turning into an inconspicuous alleyway.

a chihuahua slowly emerges from behind a dumpster. "you're late."
"i am aware. but i will no longer be doing business with you." he responds.
the chihuahua is not pleased with this statement.
"very well, then. i guess this is the end." the chihuahua goes back behind
the dumpster. 4.367 seconds later, the chihuahua reappears holding a 4ft
sword. "you were nothing but a poor writer anyway. ill be better off with
someone else."

he unstraps his pencil from his back and holds it at the ready. "the pen is
mightier than the sword!" he exclaims. the chihuahua lunges forward and he
blocks. a duel has ensued. a true test of the power of the pen[cil] versus
the power of the sword.

heard from the alleyway, the distinct sound of wood against metal. quick,
quiet shuffling sounds. a short audible gasp. impaled. a final breath.

only one leaves the alley alive.

the baby duckling
From: Natalie Miesak <4804135947@students.ocps.net>
To: Tyler Szydlo <4804136151@students.ocps.net>, Brandon Nova <4804241180@students.ocps.net>, Olivia Yip <4804085190@students.ocps.net>, Lauren Willman <4804089800@students.ocps.net>, Gianna Kim <4804135863@students.ocps.net>, Pari Vyas <4804150017@students.ocps.net>

Message-ID: <CAGZ_XgAUtS2uD7uhmv1jshaL1niFbOj3kG7Q5BczZOvqW1gFog@mail.gmail.com>

once upon a time there was a cute baby duckling that had bright yellow fur.
the baby duckling was very special. the baby duckling had fire instead of
hair, so it always looked like it was rocking a very stylish and colorful
mohawk. however, because of the baby duckling's uniqueness, the other
ducklings never wanted to play with the baby duckling.

"why dont you want to play with me?" asked the baby duckling one day.
"because youll kill us all!" replied the other ducklings.

this made the baby duckling very sad. how could the baby duckling fix this?
the next day the baby duckling went to school with the other ducklings. the
baby duckling had to take a macroeconomics test, but accidentally burned
its scrap paper. the baby duckling didn't know what to do. the baby
duckling decided to leave class and go home. on the way home, the baby
duckling caught and fried up some fresh frogs to have a tasty snack.

when the baby duckling got home, it put the frog bones on the shelf along
with its other frog bone collectibles. the baby duckling lived in a very
nice hole sitting at the bottom of the lake. then the baby duckling decided
it was time to do something meaningful with its life. the baby duckling
left the hole and climbed up the nearest tree. in the tree, the baby
duckling found a very wise owl.

"hello wise owl!" said the duckling. "how can i make friends?"
the owl was very scared. "you're on fire!" the owl swiftly flew away.

the baby ducking took that remark as a compliment. *I AM ON FIRE* the baby
duckling thought. yes, it is on fire.

the baby duckling went to school the next day feeling better than ever. the
baby duckling decided the best way to make friends would be to spread the
joy of being on fire. now it would have all the friends it wanted.

the end.

story time (endgame edition ft. brandon collab)
From: Natalie Miesak <4804135947@students.ocps.net>
To: Lauren Willman <4804089800@students.ocps.net>, Tyler Szydlo <4804136151@students.ocps.net>, Gianna Kim <4804135863@students.ocps.net>, Olivia Yip <4804085190@students.ocps.net>, Brandon Nova <4804241180@students.ocps.net>, Pari Vyas <4804150017@students.ocps.net>
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2024 21:57:05 -0500
Labels: Archived, Important, Opened, Category Personal, Starred, MEMORIES ARCHIVE
Message-ID: <CAGZ_XgBGUeCJ7Nef2pSQDL_cgXvOz_Yf_v39Ehz4V2Z4QQjOtg@mail.gmail.com>

The soothing breeze, whispers of leaves, and an eerily comfortable silence.
A flash of someone's eyes, and then none.

>From a towering stone building comes Lauren, having left after subduing
Olivia and outwitting Brandon. The rain is now a gentle pour, as she
continues her journey back home. Gianna rides on her shoulders as they
venture away from the prison, Natalie a fading memory.

In Tyler's house sits a beautiful dress- it's blue, as is representative of
his persona as indicated by the 2014 Erikson book. The clock strikes
midnight, and suddenly Tyler appears normally again. The dress is nowhere
to be seen. As it's another 4 hours until his bedtime, Tyler resumes
watching videos on how to fold hoodies.

On her way home Lauren is passing by a neighborhood. She deposits Gianna to
her home in a worm hole. Gianna shrinks down to the size of a beetle and
enters her worm hole. Lauren continues walking through the neighborhood.
The rain has slowed to a slight drizzle. Silence fills the air except for
the rustling of grass and the damp steps from Lauren's shoes. She notices a
slight movement from the corner of her eye. From a certain house out comes
Tyler, doing his daily walk at 3am.
"What are *you* doing here?" says Tyler. "This is my turf!"
"No, this is God's turf!" replies Lauren.

Lauren unsheathes her 24ft 14 karat gold sword. She uses the power of her
brain to materialize a wide 99.999% platinum shield. She lets out a sharp
shriek, and a lightning bolt bolts down from the sky, encasing her in a
blinding light. The light retreats, and Lauren is encased in full golden
body armor. She is literally on fire. Lauren is prepared to fight Tyler to
the death.

Tyler has no weapon.

Lauren raises her shield, points her sword at Tyler, and advances towards
him full force. She raises her sword to strike, and Tyler barely dives out
of the way. In the corner of his eye, Tyler sees a very long stick. The
perfect weapon. He just has to get to it first. Lauren swipes her sword
again, aiming for Tyler's head. Tyler rolls out of the way and quickly gets
on his feet. Lauren is blocking the way to the stick. How will he get
there? Tyler has an idea.
"Look! Natalie escaped from the prison!"
Lauren looks back. She is confused.
"What? No she didn't. I left her there."
Tyler sees his chance. He runs past Lauren, the stick just within reach.
But Lauren is too fast. She sees the stick and immediately sees what he is
trying to do. She throws her shield at Tyler and knocks him to the ground.
Lauren slowly approaches, sword raised. She swings her sword and strikes,
but the sword makes contact with the ground. Tyler has turned into a
beautiful blue dress. Lauren missed.

The dress transforms back into Tyler and he grabs the stick and swiftly
backs away. Lauren, enraged, is prepared to strike again. But just as she
raises her sword, it disappears. The fire around her swiftly fades away.
Her shield and armor dissolve into thin air.
Lauren is very confused. She looks at Tyler. "What happened?"
"This is some dark magic. It must be the work of a witch!" exclaims Tyler.
Immediately Lauren thinks of 1 person. She very dramatically turns to
Tyler, a serious look in her eye.
"Olivia." she says very seriously. "We need to find her and destroy her!"

Lauren and Tyler venture off into the forest. They go back to the worm hole
to search for Gianna. They call for Gianna, but nothing emerges from the
hole. Lauren has a brilliant idea, and pulls a piece of kimchi out of her
pocket. She lays the kimchi in front of the hole, planning to lure Gianna
out of the hole. It doesn't take long for Gianna to take the bait. A cute
little small beetle crawls out of the hole and turns into Gianna. They
explain their situation with the dark magic witch Olivia, and Gianna agrees
to help defeat her. But this isn't enough. They need more manpower, more
firepower, more willpower. Lauren has the perfect idea.

The heroic trio sprint their way through the forest, hurdling over fallen
tree trunks and dodging pesky bugs. Gianna occasionally stops to take a
nap, and Lauren has to lay a trail of kimchi so Gianna can catch up after
napping. After traveling for 3 days and 5 nights, the trio decides to make
camp. The sun is beginning to set, and soon darkness will be among them.
Gianna digs a nice hole for herself and nibbles on her last piece of
kimchi. She feels sleepy again, so she turns into a beetle and retreats
deeper into the hole. Tyler climbs a tree and rests on one of the branches.
He turns into a beautiful blue dress and hangs peacefully in the breeze.
Lauren reaches for her sword so she can cut down some fresh branches and
build shelter, but remembers that Olivia the Evil Sorcerer has dissolved
her sword. Lauren slowly lays down on the cold, hard ground and tries to
fall asleep.

A sweet, fruity smell fills the air as the sun's rays begin to peek through
the trees. Music dances past Lauren's ears as she hears the songs of birds
alongside the crisp crackling of a campfire. She looks over to see Tyler
and Gianna resting beside the fire, cooking mysterious red berries.
"Are you sure we can eat those?" questioned Lauren.
Tyler gives her a quizzical look as if this is common knowledge. "Yes, all
mysterious berries are safe to eat."
Lauren does not question Tyler's judgement. Gianna has already eaten
several berries (in beetle form). Lauren grabs a berry off the fire and
plops it in her mouth. The taste is immaculate. She takes possession of all
the berries and downs them all in no more than 5 seconds.
"Alright, let's continue!" exclaims Lauren. The three get up and continue
their journey through the forest. Tyler is sad because he didn't get to eat
any mysterious berries.

The triumphant trio find themselves back at the large stone prison. The
serious guard stands in front, performing his job very seriously. Lauren
makes her way across the moat and confidently approaches the guard.
"We need your help!" Lauren exclaims.
"Sure, I will help!" responds Brandon the Guard. Brandon closes the gate to
the prison, fully prepared to leave his post and help the group. They
desperately need him and he knows it. Brandon will provide the best
willpower to the group. The ferocious four run into the distance, prepared
to bring Olivia down once and for all.

~~ intermission ~~

The four reach the edges of the forest, seeing a large metropolis on the
horizon. A massive cloud looms over the whole city. It is moving slowly,
ominously, in a large spiral. In the center of the spiral, a large
skyscraper reaches up. That is Olivia's fortress. This is where the four
must venture.
Gianna has an undying urge to eat chicken wings. The city is so close- all
they have to do is make a pit stop. Gianna voices her concerns to the
group. "I'm hungry :(" Everyone turns to Gianna and thinks for a bit. They
decide that they need someone to scout out the area anyway, otherwise
they'll be going into the battlefield blind. Tyler volunteers to go map out
the tower and the area around it so he can formulate a plan while the
others get chicken wings. He is very hungry, but he is also still salty
about Lauren eating all the berries. He needs time to cool down.
Tyler turns into a dress and moves like a flying carpet off into the
distance. He is a very stealthy scout. The others venture to another part
of the city in search of chicken wings.


7 hours later, the four regroup at the chicken wing place. Gianna, Lauren,
and Brandon are very satisfied and full with chicken wings. Tyler is
satisfied with a job well done in scouting out Olivia's palace, but he
comes with urgent news. Natalie is being held prisoner in Olivia's tower.
They must formulate a plan to save her!
"What?! Do we have to?" exclaimed Lauren. "She'll be fine."
The others disagree. They must rescue her! They swiftly head out, ready to
stop Olivia once and for all.

The big city skyline looms over everyone. A tense uneasiness over the
population, rumors of some pending crisis, the uneasiness of the current
calm. Natalie is held hostage at the top of 200 Park Ave 10166, and Tyler,
Lauren, and Gianna stand at the bottom, on the road leading from Grand
central station. Brandon quickly goes to the top to try to free Natalie,
but is stopped suddenly. Olivia stands in front of him. "Stop",  she says.
Brandon stops, then immediately runs to save Natalie, "You didn't say how
long". Olivia tackles him violently and puts him in a cage seperate to
Natalie (covid 19 social distancing). Unable to see because it's far away
and two thirds of them are borderline blind Tyler, Lauren, and Gianna stand
at the bottom trying to figure out what to do next.

The tremendous trio bolt up the stairs. They stand face to face with
Olivia, her sorceress staff at the ready. Lauren runs around in circles,
aiming to distract Olivia. Tyler turns into a flying dress and also travels
in circles, also aiming to distract Olivia. Gianna transforms into a
beetle, swiftly enters Brandon's cage, and unlocks it. Brandon begins
shouting words of encouragement as Lauren and Olivia engage in hand-to-hand
combat.
"Give me back my 24ft 14 karat gold sword!" demanded Lauren.
"Never!" politely responded Olivia.

Gianna (still in beetle form) stealthily and swiftly approaches Olivia as
she continues to 1-on-1 battle Lauren. Brandon continues to provide
excellent willpower, and Tyler continues to fly in circles, creating giant
gusts of wind. Lauren kicks Olivia, then grabs Olivia's arm and judo-flips
her over her shoulder. Lauren pins Olivia's shoulders to the ground. She is
trapped. Olivia slowly grabs her staff, ready to unleash a powerful spell.
But just then- SWOOSH! Gianna the Beetle flies through the air and lands in
Olivia's eye.
"AAAHH! A BEETLE!!!" Olivia calmly proclaimed. "Fine! I surrender!"

Lauren helps Olivia up. "SIKE!" Olivia suddenly whips out her staff and
smacks Lauren in the stomach. The battle continues. Brandon is now shouting
even more encouraging words of encouragement, and Tyler speeds up his
circles. Gianna turns back into human form.
"Stop! Can't we all be friends?"
Olivia and Lauren stop fighting for a second. They ponder this for a moment.
"Yes, we should be friends," Olivia says.
Everyone stops fighting and groups together in the center of the room.
Tyler turns back into human form, the winds still blowing in circles.
Lauren, Gianna, Brandon, Tyler, and Olivia all do a group hug. Their issue
is resolved, and Olivia will no longer be an evil sorceress. Hurrah!

Just then Brandon looks back and sees something frightening. A giant
tornado has formed in the room during their group hug. Tyler flew too fast!
The ground begins to rumble, the ceiling cracking and shaking. The building
is going to collapse! The ferocious four quickly make their way out of the
tower. As soon as they reach the ground, pieces of the tower begin hitting
the ground. A sinkhole forms as the tower caves in on itself. Luckily, all
the main characters made it out safely.

*Final scene where olivia is a good guy*

*Everyone hugs and is friends*

The end. Remember to Never Eat Soggy Waffles.

Good morning,

You have been approved for Senior Flip Day. Please remember the following:

  *   Participating seniors must act and dress professionally as they are representing a school member, and they must make up all work they missed from any and all classes.
  *    Dress code still applies. No basketball shorts (unless you're flipping with a coach and that is what they typically wear). No short, low cut, or see-through apparel.
  *   The staff person is still ultimately in charge and you are still a student so Code of Conduct still applies.
  *   You are expected to remain with your flip person all day.
  *   This should be a fun experience but it can also be a great way to learn more about the role you are taking on.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

Thank you,

Lauren and Tyler battle
From: Natalie Miesak <4804135947@students.ocps.net>
To: Brandon Nova <4804241180@students.ocps.net>
Date: Fri, 09 Feb 2024 19:55:32 -0500
Labels: Archived, Important, Opened, Category Personal, MEMORIES ARCHIVE
Message-ID: <CAGZ_XgBVz1=QWEUuELvBwKLcAoQz6EYJ0iY3kE-J_QkBvWr7Pg@mail.gmail.com>

Thought you might want to read the luren and Tyler battle

Lauren continues walking through the neighborhood. From a certain house out
comes Tyler, doing his daily walk at 3am.
"What are *you* doing here?" says Tyler. "This is my turf!"
"No, this is God's turf!" replies Lauren.

Lauren unsheathes her 24ft 14 karat gold sword. She uses the power of her
brain to materialize a wide 99.999% platinum shield. She lets out a sharp
shriek, and a lightning bolt bolts down from the sky, encasing her in a
blinding light. The light retreats, and Lauren is encased in full golden
body armor. She is literally on fire. Lauren is prepared to fight Tyler to
the death.

Tyler has no weapon.

Lauren raises her shield, points her sword at Tyler, and advances towards
him full force. She raises her sword to strike, and Tyler just barely dives
out of the way. In the corner of his eye, Tyler sees a very long stick. The
perfect weapon. He just has to get to it first. Lauren swipes her sword
again, aiming for Tyler's head. Tyler rolls out of the way and quickly gets
on his feet. Lauren is blocking the way to the stick. How will he get
there? Tyler has an idea.
"Look! Natalie escaped from the prison!"
Lauren looks back. She is confused.
"What? No she didn't. I left her there."
Tyler saw his chance. He runs past Lauren, the stick just within reach. But
Lauren is too fast. She sees the stick and immediately sees what he is
trying to do. She throws her shield at Tyler and knocks him to the ground.
Lauren slowly approaches, sword raised. She swings her sword and strikes,
but the sword makes contact with the ground. Tyler has turned into a
beautiful blue dress. Lauren missed.

The dress transforms back into Tyler and he grabs the stick and swiftly
backs away. Lauren, enraged, is prepared to strike again. But just as she
raises her sword, it disappears. The fire around her swiftly fades away.
Her shield and armor dissolve into thin air.
Lauren is very confused. She looks at Tyler. "What happened?"
"This is some dark magic. It must be the work of a witch!" exclaims Tyler.
Immediately Lauren thought of 1 person. She very dramatically turns to
Tyler, a serious look in her eye.
"Olivia." she says very seriously. "We need to find her and destroy her!"

Attention Seniors!

Here's your opportunity to take over for the day. You can choose any faculty or staff member on campus. You ask the person and they will let you know if they agree to flip with you. You are expected to attend school for the entire day unless you are sharing with someone. Sharing is allowed but all parties must agree. Complete the Google Form<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfw6zg0EwBt_S_MbiUWE9FG5TWUXnhEW-G84XinbIm6PJfhvw/viewform?usp=sf_link> and upload your permission slip<https://docs.google.com/document/d/1LAAgKA7rwtM6Xi3uhZvgq6Jc6ubcV0dIDNy9r8eJv54/edit?usp=sharing> by Friday, 2/2/2024.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

EMAIL 268 OF 480 | mail-00412
